attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"though a truce is a start","severity":"minor","reason":"implies the feast produced a truce; briefing only says a peace feast was held, and implies prior hostility"},{"span":"As I reported last time, the Hearthguard Compact is offering prizes for new inventions.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news; it is the second-to-last bulletin, not the last, and the instruction says to lead only with new things and mention old at most in a short clause"}],"voice":4,"clarity":4,"tone":4,"overall":3,"comment":"The dry voice works and the new item leads, but the second item pads with old news and ignores the one-new-thing rule (1 item, 40-80 words). The 'truce' wording also adds a small unsupported implication."}
